cabins.name: Saga Premium seats
cabins.description: Twenty-two Aviointeriors Andromeda recliner seats arranged in a 2-2 configuration. Each seat features an adjustable head rest and adjustable foot rest

cabins.name: Economy seats
cabins.description: 161 Aviointeriors Columbus slimline seats arranged in a 3-3 configuration. Each seat features an adjustable head rest
